text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The government seeks to curb tax evasion.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia to visit Tunisia on Friday.
- The government adopts draft laws on customs, agriculture and privatisation.
- National Liberation Front rejects President Liamine Zeroual proposal to join the Transitional National Council.
- Algeria's risk rating abroad has improved, says economist Rachid Sekkak.
- Algerian Sport Minister Mouldi Aissaoui elected president of Africa High Sport Council.
- Algerian Renewal Party (PRA) says its representatives in the Transitional National Council voted against an approved law on compulsory use of Arabic language in public life.
